cause_quote: The CLI runner added `replyToMode: turn.followupRun.originatingReplyToMode ?? turn.sessionCtx.ReplyToMode`, passing Slack’s raw `off` through the MCP grant and overriding the message tool’s thread-aware default.
user_saw: When a CLI agent used the message tool without specifying a thread ID, its reply appeared at the Slack channel root instead of in the thread where the turn began.
summary: The fix makes CLI message-tool sends use the channel adapter’s thread target and reply mode when the adapter requires replies to stay in the originating thread.
reasoning: In the causing commit’s parent, the CLI path already carried the originating Slack thread ID through the MCP grant, and the message tool defaulted to `all` when it had a thread ID and no supplied reply mode. The causing diff forwarded the raw `off` value end to end, bypassing that fallback and causing Slack’s same-channel auto-thread resolver to omit the thread ID.
